reviews.review: Very entertaining game, especially with friends. Lots of stuff to unlock. I like it.

I've only played for a few hours but I can already tell that this game is legit. You can tell that the team put a lot of attention and care into the gameplay, the visuals, the menus... everything is solid. And aside from the gameplay being great there's a ton of stuff to unlock. I slept on this game and wish that I hadn't; they don't make them like this anymore.

I have to say that I don't understand the negative reviews at all. It's a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ blast.

Update: I just beat the campaign (haven't played the DLC yet). It was incredibly fun. I'm honestly blown away by the quality and fidelity of the game; the graphics are awesome, the animations are awesome (especially the aliens), the guns feel good, the sound effects are great, the level design, atmosphere, music... I could go on.

All in all this is an extremely well made game that is also a ton of fun to play. After I get tired of it, I can see myself coming back every so often to play through the campain with a friend or two again. There are so many ways to increase the challenge and change the gameplay, it's actually overwhelming.

One thing I wish they did is that when they made the challenge cards free, they should've just made them not be consumed upon use, and they should've just given every challenge card to every player when they did that. Because as it stands currently, you have to spam buy challenge cards for free (randomly, you don't control which ones you get). It's not an elegant solution and it's kind of annoying, but it's a minor complaint.

Tl;dr: Buy this game - it's worth it whether or not it's on sale. Basically Zombie Army Trilogy in space.

Fun and stays true to the original aesthetic of the Alien/Aliens movies.  If you like Aliens (second movie) then you'll love this.  Can be played solo but it's best done with a couple of friends.  I'm not too far into it but one thing I think is well done is balancing.  Look up what gun is best and you'll find a complete discussion of different takes and answers.  It really seems to boil down to personal preference and that's a good thing.

After playing over 100 hours and earning 100% of the achievements, I can confidently say that Aliens: Fireteam Elite is one of the most enjoyable co-op shooters I’ve played in years. The game offers a fantastic mix of intense action, atmospheric environments, and a faithful recreation of the Aliens universe.

What truly sets this game apart is its replayability. The class system, along with the wide variety of perks and weapon customization options, keeps the gameplay fresh even after dozens of missions. Each class feels distinct and valuable, encouraging different team strategies and loadouts.

Whether you're diving in solo with AI companions or teaming up with friends, there's always a reason to come back—be it to try a new build, take on a harder difficulty, or simply enjoy mowing down Xenomorph hordes in style. It’s clear the developers put a lot of love into this title, and it pays off.

Highly recommended for fans of the Aliens franchise or anyone looking for a solid, rewarding co-op experience.
